what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/take-a-booking-one-step-at-a-time: the booking page a person is taken through one step at a time.

payload.label: Read a booking page
payload.job: Read one live booking page: its title, time zone, session length, windows and the questions its form asks
payload.description: Answers the booking page named by page from the pursuit database (booking_pages and the form it names in form_rows): its title, time zone, minutes per session, the windows it offers, how many days ahead and the minimum notice, and its questions in the form's order. A page that is not live, has no windows or has no questions is refused by name. The open times are not read here: the booking routes answer them. The answer is the props of show/BookingPage.tsx.

database.description: The name of the pursuit database to read, bound by the trusted caller. The engine opens it with the login its vault holds as that name and -connection; no caller supplies a login.

use.description: The use this statement runs for: a recipe step's declared purpose and surface (config.context.use, set by the workflow engine over any use the step's input carried). Given with database, the computer opens the database with its reader login (one that cannot get round the row rules, change a table or read the use binding) instead of the owner's, and hands the run a ticket of this use that it signed; the statement's transaction claims it first, so the database's row rules read this use and the statement cannot change it. A use with credential_name, which has no ticket, is refused. Absent: the owner's own work, read under the database's own purpose_when_unstated.

purpose.description: The purpose path, such as publish or coach/review.

surface.description: The surface path, such as social/instagram; empty for any surface.

provenance.source: Written in tools/take-a-booking-one-step-at-a-time/do-work from the behaviour of the pages it replaces, made generic; read through run-sql-in-my-database/do-work/serve-a-read.ts

payload.label: Start a booking
payload.job: Open one person's booking with their email, one step at a time
payload.description: Opens a sitting of the live booking page named by page with the booker's email, and answers its id (attemptId) and the first step to draw (the first question, or the time). A page that is not live, has no times or no questions is refused by name; a bad email is refused by naming the rule, never the value.

database.description: The name of the pursuit database that holds the sittings, bound by the trusted caller. The engine opens it with the login its vault holds as that name and -connection; no caller supplies a login.

email.description: The booker's email address, as they typed it.

use.description: The use this step runs for (a site's declared pages use, or a recipe step's config.context.use). Given with database, the computer opens the database with its writer login (one that may add or change only the columns the writer recipe may-write-named-columns-under-a-use named, and never change a table) instead of the owner's, and hands the run a ticket of this use that it signed; the step's one transaction claims it first. A share act's run must give it. Absent: the owner's own work, with the owner's login.

payload.label: Answer a booking question
payload.job: Keep one answer of a booking and say the next step
payload.description: Checks the value as the booking's waiting question asks it, keeps it as that question's answer (answering the same question again replaces it) and answers the next step to draw. A value that fails the question's rule is refused by naming the rule, never the value. A booking already made is refused.

payload.label: Work out a booking's window
payload.job: Say the span a booking's open times are read over, so the calendar's busy times are asked for that span
payload.description: Answers from (now) and to (now plus the booking page's horizon in days), each an instant in whole seconds like 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z: the input of tool:check-when-i-am-busy for the sitting's open times. It reads the sitting and its page with the booking's own login, so the caller (a site's row) needs no read of the sittings or the pages. A sitting whose page is not open, has no times or no questions is refused. Changes nothing.

payload.label: Read a booking's open times
payload.job: List the times a booking can be made at, from the page's windows and the calendar's busy times
payload.description: Answers the open start times of the booking's page over its horizon: its weekly windows, less the busy times given, less the minimum notice. Needs busy_read (the whole answer of tool:check-when-i-am-busy) and works only when its status is read; without it nothing is answered, so an unread calendar is never taken for a free one. Changes nothing.

database.description: The name of the pursuit database that holds the sittings, bound by the trusted caller. The engine opens it with the login its vault holds as that name and -connection; no caller supplies a login.

attemptId.description: The sitting's id, as the start step answered it.

busy_read.description: The whole answer of tool:check-when-i-am-busy: { status, busy }. Works only when status is read (busy is then the list of { start, end } instants, empty for a free calendar); any other answer is refused, so a calendar that was not read is never taken for a free one.

payload.label: Choose a booking's time
payload.job: Keep the time a person chose for their booking, if it is open
payload.description: Keeps the chosen start as the booking's time only when it is one of the open starts worked out now from the page's windows and the busy times given; a made-up or taken time is refused and nothing is kept. Answers the next step and the time's start and end.

payload.label: Check a booking is ready
payload.job: Say the calendar event a booking is ready to make, once its time is still open
payload.description: Checks the booking is at its confirm step and its chosen time is still open (from the calendar read given), then answers the input of tool:put-a-booking-on-my-calendar: the title, the start and end in the page's own clock, the zone, the booker as attendee and a video call request. Makes no event and writes nothing; tool:keep-a-made-booking keeps the booking once the event is made.

payload.label: Keep a made booking
payload.job: Keep the booking row of an event that was made, and end the booking
payload.description: Writes the booking row (naming its sitting, its time, its booker and the event) and ends the sitting together, once; a sitting already ended is refused, so one event is kept once. event is the answer of tool:put-a-booking-on-my-calendar (its external_event_id, and video_link when there is one). When this is refused, cancel the event with tool:cancel-a-booking-on-my-calendar.

event.description: The answer of the tool that made the event: { external_event_id, video_link? }.
